core.headline: Two-Bedroom Mid-Terrace House, Sheerness – Guide Price £150,000
core.listing:
A two-bedroom mid-terrace house in Sheerness, offered for sale by Modern Method of Auction with a 56-day reservation period. The property requires modernisation and is available with no onward chain. A non-refundable reservation fee of 4.2% of the purchase price (minimum £6,000) including VAT is payable by the buyer in addition to the purchase price.

The ground floor comprises a reception room. The first floor provides two bedrooms and a bathroom.

Outside there is a rear yard. On-street parking is available without a permit.

For sale by Modern Method of Auction. Guide Price £150,000. The guide price indicates the seller's minimum expectation; the reserve will be within 10% of the guide. 56-day reservation period. Non-refundable reservation fee of 4.2% of the purchase price (minimum £6,000) including VAT, payable by the buyer in addition to the purchase price. Freehold. Council Tax Band A (Swale Borough Council). EPC rating E. Standard construction. Mains electricity, mains water (metered), mains sewerage and gas central heating. FTTC broadband and good outdoor mobile signal coverage on major networks. On-street parking, no permit required. Building safety, restrictions, rights and easements, flooding, coastal erosion, planning, accessibility and coalfield/mining: none known.
core.summary: For sale by Modern Method of Auction. Mid-terrace house requiring modernisation in Sheerness, with two bedrooms, rear yard and no onward chain. Guide Price £150,000. Freehold.
